exposure: infra-renal abdominal aortic balloon occlusion above the ovarian artery
cohort: 32 pregnant women with coexisting placenta accreta and placenta previa treated with prophylactic abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (PABO)
finding: The location of the balloon (above or below the ovarian arteries) during prophylactic abdominal aortic balloon occlusion did not influence outcomes in women with placenta accreta and placenta previa.
